children: New Zealand dairy processor reported FY26 revenue of NZ$1.94 bln after difficult first half
Company posted FY26 net loss after tax of NZ$75.4 mln, with smaller underlying loss
Synlait will not provide quantitative earnings guidance for five-month transitional period to Dec 2026
Synlait withholds TP26 earnings guidance, citing the five-month period's short, non-comparable and seasonal nature
Company forecasts a 2026/27 base milk price of $9.50/kgMS, excluding incentives
Synlait plans to share its scale strategy in 2027 after stabilising and simplifying operations
TACTICAL MILK SALES – Tactical raw milk sales generated NZ$37.0 mln of losses as capacity was prioritised for Advanced Nutrition production
MANUFACTURING DISRUPTION – Operational disruption, plan changes and tighter quality controls reduced Advanced Nutrition gross profit 78% to NZ$20.9 mln
CONSUMER AND FOODSERVICE – Consumer gross profit rose 32% on Dairyworks export strength and liquid-milk margins, while Foodservice benefited from pricing and lower fat costs
Sept 24 - New Zealand appoints Rebecca Williams to central bank's monetary policy committee
